integrity: The proof derives the finite Alexandrov collapse from finiteness, identifies dense opens through maximal specialization classes, and then gives an exact nested-tail classification on chains. The recent primary article was inspected at its definitions of up-spaces, specialization order, density, and coherent justification; the closely related iS4 topological-semantics paper was compared for broader coverage. Targeted literature and published-finding searches did not locate the least-dense-core theorem or the exact chain census.
scientific_limitations: The Alexandrov collapse and least-dense-open theorem require a finite carrier. The exact count 2^(n-1) is for a fixed labelled intuitionistic chain and does not count modal-equivalence classes.
title: Finite topological-evidence models have a least dense specialization core
